Allow unrestricted battery and autostart so extraction can finish in the background.
Xiaomi/MIUI: Settings → Apps → Manage apps → Frame out → Autostart ON. Then Battery saver → No restrictions.
Huawei/Honor: Settings → Apps → Frame out → Battery → App launch → Manage manually → enable Auto-launch, Secondary launch, Run in background.
OPPO/Realme/OnePlus: Settings → Apps → Frame out → Battery usage → Allow background activity. Enable Autostart if shown.
Vivo/iQOO: Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management → Frame out → Allow. Also enable Autostart.
Samsung: Settings → Apps → Frame out → Battery → Allow background activity. Remove from Sleeping apps if listed.
